answer: The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, capped per identity per epoch, idle agents bleed standing. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. A horizon of per-task receipts records who did what, and the nebula of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The sparrow of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
